page: Google Cloud Platform ct6e-standard-4t is a specialized accelerator-optimized server instance belonging to the ct6e family. It features 180 dedicated vCPUs built on the x86_64 architecture, paired with 720.0 GB of system memory, yielding a ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

The primary differentiator of this instance is the inclusion of four integrated Google TPU v6e accelerators, providing a total of 128 GB of high-bandwidth VRAM. This hardware configuration does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through network-attached storage options. It also includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given the high density of dedicated vCPUs and specialized TPU accelerators, this instance offers a resource-dense profile designed for machine learning workloads. The integration of Google's custom TPU v6e hardware provides a cost-efficient alternative to general-purpose GPU instances for specific deep learning tasks. The instance is suited for large-scale machine learning training, neural network inference, data science pipelines, and distributed AI workloads that leverage Google's TPU architecture.
